name: Darcy
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Darcy keeps the town's defenders fed and spirits up. She serves drinks and warm meals, with a special care for Guard Parker.

sections.title: A Friendly Face at the Inn
sections.body: Darcy keeps the Lakeshire Inn's counter working through long days and nights. The town's militia come there for food and drink while gnolls and Blackrock orcs keep Lakeshire under pressure. Darcy also looks out for guards posted around town. She asks travelers to carry hot meals and friendly errands to defenders stationed along the borders.

sections.title: Romance on the Guard Post
sections.body: Darcy pays special attention to Guard Parker, who patrols the roads near Three Corners. She thinks he works too hard on an empty stomach and often sends travelers with lunch for him. Darcy watches Martie Jainrose closely, believing her to be jealous and a rival for Parker's favor. Their feelings mingle with the work of defending Lakeshire.

faq.answer: Darcy works as a human waitress at the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains. She prepares food for the town's defenders and asks passing travelers to deliver meals to guards on duty.

faq.q: What is Darcy's relationship with Guard Parker?
faq.answer: Darcy is deeply fond of Guard Parker. She packs him fresh lunches and sends them with travelers while he patrols the roads near Three Corners.

faq.q: Why is Darcy suspicious of Martie Jainrose?
faq.answer: Darcy thinks Martie Jainrose is jealous and sees her as a romantic rival for Guard Parker's attention.
You can find Darcy serving patrons at the Lakeshire Inn in Lakeshire, by the northern shore of Lake Everstill in Redridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can find Darcy among Lakeshire's everyday folk, keeping spirits high and bellies full while the town waits for aid from Stormwind.
